newsitem.title: INDIA: India bus accident kills seven, injures 21.
newsitem.headline: India bus accident kills seven, injures 21.

text.p: A bus crash killed at least seven people and injured 21 in India's northern state of Jammu and Kashmir on Tuesday, the United News of India said.
The accident happened 80 km (50 miles) from Jammu, the state's winter capital, the agency said without giving further details.
Communications in the region are often slow because the terrain is mountainous and roads at times unpassable.
Nearly 50,000 people die in road accidents every year in India.
